scope.description: כל הספרים, המהדורות הזמינות וקישורי המקורות במסד הנתונים הרשמי של תוכנת אוצריא.
scope.content: All canonical application books, primary text, inline notes, available alternate edition texts, edition metadata, source notices and outgoing links with range/anchor/suppression metadata. Companion Talmud PDFs are imported separately. The external provider catalog is downloaded by the native installer and published separately as link metadata; provider listings are disabled by default. The lexical search database is a separate application download. Embedded raster images are preserved as content-addressed static media; original missing image sources are explicitly reported.

sources.attribution: קובצי התלמוד הבבלי המצורפים להפצה הרשמית של אוצריא. פרטי המקור נשמרים בקובצי ה-PDF.

externalScope.content: Bibliographic metadata and source links; no remote provider PDF payloads.

notes: The actual generated Pagefind JavaScript and WebAssembly run in Node with file-backed fetch, without sockets or a browser.
Timings include local file I/O and CPU only; they are not CDN, mobile, or end-user latency measurements.
Fetch byte totals are generated response-body sizes, not HTTP wire bytes. The direct module import and browser worker script are listed separately.
RSS includes the Node process and shared WebAssembly runtime, so it is not a direct measurement of browser-tab memory.
checks: All45 generated entry page_count values agree with the manifest and sum to223835
Provider filters partition the ordinary-title matches, without assuming one provider has no Genesis books
Both UI-normalized and native raw quoted source-title lookup include HB14020 after punctuation-only-token removal; source title metadata remains unchanged
Known exact title and author records are searchable with the correct native URLs and real generated local anchors
All fetches stayed within external/pagefind; no core index or remote provider content was fetched
